facts.fact: Nigeria's Federal Government inaugurated a steering committee on 14 August 2026 whose terms of reference include developing a framework for adopting the 1Gov Cloud as the sovereign digital work environment for federal operations, with Galaxy Backbone as infrastructure provider.

NGA.note: Framework still to be developed; no hosting in service stated.

systems.system: Digital Transformation of the Federal Civil Service
systems.country_label: FEC-approved digital transformation of the federal civil service
systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation

NGA.note: Civil service only, a government-only plan.
Only procurement channels for MDAs; no citizen-facing services count stated.
No system stated as built or run by government staff; the BPP reforms and Galaxy Backbone role are not tied to staff building or running.
No data centre for hire or its ownership stated.
